title: Customizable Pearl Cooldown
description: Allows you to choose the duration of the cooldown of Ender Pearls
body:
## Customizable Pearl Cooldown
Make the Ender Pearl's cooldown longer.

## How to use
Enter **/function pearl_cooldown:config**

You can now use the slider to enter the amount of time (in seconds) that you want the pearl cooldown to be.

![This is what the UI looks like](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/36cd074be2b998cc48e05ccbaf23df0bd5dd4f85.png)


<details>
<summary>Notes</summary>

_The cooldown can only be from 1 to 60 seconds._ 

_You might have issues with the pearls not stacking when entering your inventory when dropped from an Enderman or when trading with a cleric villager, but they will stack correctly when they are moved around in your inventory._

</details>
<details>
<summary>Installation</summary>
  
### Server Installation (Datapack)
  
1. Go in the main server file
  
2. Open _world_ -> _datapacks_

3. Upload the datapack in the _datapacks_ folder

### World Installation (Datapack)

1. Press Win + R and enter %appdata%

2. Open _.minecraft_ -> _saves_ -> _<world name>_ -> datapacks

3. Upload the datapack in the _datapacks_ folder

(Note that if you are using a launcher like Modrinth App or Prism Launcher, you'll need to go on your instance on the launcher and click on _Open Folder_.)

### Server Installation (Mod)

1. Go in the main server file

2. Open _mods_

3. Upload the mod in the _mods_ folder
</details>
